strengths: Well-motivated problem: Identifies an important and underexplored gap in unified 3D understanding and generation with clear articulation of key challenges

Thoughtful system design: Three-stage training pipeline is well-reasoned and each component (geometric-semantic encoder, Spatial-VAE, unified training) is clearly motivated and ablated

weaknesses: Limited component novelty: Geometric-semantic encoder largely combines existing techniques (MASt3R + RADIOv2.5); Spatial-VAE and diffusion generation are standard approaches; novelty is primarily in integration
